SELECT DATE(g.apply_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM gate_open g WHERE g.deleted = 0
AND g.apply_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND g.apply_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND g.station_id = #{stationId}
GROUP BY DATE(g.apply_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT s.name AS stationName, COUNT(g.id) AS count FROM gate_open g LEFT JOIN station_info s ON g.station_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE g.deleted = 0
AND g.apply_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND g.apply_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND g.station_id = #{stationId}
GROUP BY g.station_id, s.name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS applyCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN g.status = '已通过' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS auditPassRate FROM gate_open g WHERE g.deleted = 0
AND g.apply_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime})
AND g.apply_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND g.station_id = #{stationId}
